title: Signal: npm client reaches the network through a cleartext proxy
scope: A .npmrc file that declares a proxy URL that uses cleartext http.
limitations: It matches a proxy URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .npmrc that mentions a proxy URL that uses cleartext http in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
